# CANDIDATE: IV_SKEW_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Moderate bullish skew (IV Skew Ratio 1.0-1.2) indicates relatively bullish options sentiment combined with a VWAP pullback in an uptrend (price above 8/21 EMA ribbon) offers high-probability longs before afternoon drift. This edge exists because the skew reflects institutional positioning favoring upside, while the VWAP pullback represents a healthy retracement where smart money often steps in during trending markets.

## Mechanism

Entry: At 30-minute bar close, if price >8/21 EMA (bullish ribbon), IV Skew Ratio (25d Call IV / Put IV) between 1.0-1.2, and price touches VWAP but closes above it, enter long at next bar open.  
Exit: Stop: below pullback bar low; Target: 2x risk (stop distance) or test of day's high.  
Regime filters: ADX>20 on 30m, VIX 12-22, optimal window 11:00-14:00 ET.
